description: Source file implementing the SimpleIndex class for disk cache management, including cache entry metadata, eviction, and disk I/O operations.

classes.name: EntryMetadata
classes.description: Holds metadata for cache entries, including last used time, size, and trailer prefetch size.

classes.name: SimpleIndex
classes.description: Manages cache index entries, eviction, and disk persistence for disk cache.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the index by loading existing entries from disk.

methods.name: SetMaxSize
methods.description: Sets the maximum cache size and updates watermarks for eviction.

methods.name: ExecuteWhenReady
methods.description: Executes a callback once the index is initialized.

methods.name: GetEntriesBetween
methods.description: Retrieves cache entries within a specified time range.

methods.name: GetAllHashes
methods.description: Retrieves all cache entry hashes.

methods.name: GetEntryCount
methods.description: Returns the number of entries in the cache index.

methods.name: GetCacheSize
methods.description: Returns the total size of cache entries.

methods.name: GetCacheSizeBetween
methods.description: Returns total size of entries within a time range.

methods.name: GetLastUsedTime
methods.description: Returns last used time for a specific entry.

methods.name: SetLastUsedTimeForTest
methods.description: Sets last used time for testing purposes.

methods.name: HasPendingWrite
methods.description: Checks if a write to disk is pending.

methods.name: Insert
methods.description: Inserts a new cache entry by hash.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes a cache entry by hash.

methods.name: Has
methods.description: Checks if an entry exists in the index.

methods.name: GetEntryInMemoryData
methods.description: Retrieves in-memory data flag for an entry.

methods.name: SetEntryInMemoryData
methods.description: Sets in-memory data flag for an entry.

methods.name: UseIfExists
methods.description: Updates last used time if entry exists, or returns true to force disk access.

methods.name: StartEvictionIfNeeded
methods.description: Initiates eviction process if cache exceeds high watermark.

methods.name: GetTrailerPrefetchSize
methods.description: Gets trailer prefetch size for an entry (app cache only).

methods.name: SetTrailerPrefetchSize
methods.description: Sets trailer prefetch size for an entry (app cache only).

methods.name: UpdateEntrySize
methods.description: Updates the size of a cache entry.

methods.name: EvictionDone
methods.description: Callback after eviction completes.

methods.name: InsertInEntrySet
methods.description: Static helper to insert an entry into the set.

methods.name: InsertEntryForTesting
methods.description: Inserts an entry for testing purposes.

methods.name: PostponeWritingToDisk
methods.description: Delays writing index to disk.

methods.name: UpdateEntryIteratorSize
methods.description: Updates size of an entry and adjusts total cache size.

methods.name: MergeInitializingSet
methods.description: Merges loaded index entries with current in-memory entries.

methods.name: OnApplicationStateChange
methods.description: Handles app background/foreground state changes (Android).

methods.name: WriteToDisk
methods.description: Persists index to disk.
